Alloy-Bench
	

Alloy-Bench is a Russian-language multiple-choice benchmark for evaluating large language models in the domain of metallurgy and mining engineering.It is designed in the spirit of MMLU-style exams and focuses on professional knowledge rather than general trivia.This is the validation split - publicly available for open evaluation and comparison.
